tvs.description-banner-inerial:
Hello. My name is Ksenia Kobilianskaia. I am the owner of LBar micropigmentation studio, a permanent makeup artist and a Master Trainer at our permanent makeup school.

When I opened my micropigmentation studio, I realized from the very start that it would be more than just a job or a way to earn money. To me, micropigmentation is a creative pursuit that inspires me not only to devote my skills to it and feel fulfilled, but also to give every client a little more happiness. For me, seeing happy eyes shining with joy as a client looks in the mirror is the greatest achievement. That's exactly why I don't stop at what I've already achieved, but stay motivated to keep improving. I've completed dozens of training and advanced courses and taken part in various offline and online events.

Our LBar micropigmentation school has trained more than 400 students to date. Our graduates successfully practice their profession in countries across Europe and Asia and in several US cities. I keep developing my teaching skills in permanent makeup.

My main goal is to give everyone who wants it the opportunity to receive quality training that lays the foundation for a profession they love and ensures them a decent income.

As the owner of the micropigmentation studio and one of its PMU artists, I guarantee that every procedure is performed to a high standard, in full compliance with hygiene and safety standards.

Every semi-permanent makeup artist working at our studio is not just a professional but a true expert in the field. That's why I'm confident in the services we provide, no matter who performs them: me or another PMU artist on our team. Creating a natural look is very important to us. We are advocates of natural beauty. And that means you won't be disappointed with the result. I assure you there will be no garish colors or strange shapes. Only elegant transformation and femininity!
